objectives.description: Migrate roughly 45 mid-size suites onto common.sh's test-helper surface (common_test_pass/_fail/_info, common_test_repo_root, common_test_resolve_candidate, common_test_workdir_init), following Phase 6's established pattern
objectives.note: Enumerated a fresh pool of 104 unmigrated core suites (up from Phase 6's 98-suite estimate, confirming the plan's own drift warning), joined against suite-cost-hints.txt, and excluded suites costing >=10s wall time (including the already-known test-verify-deploy-gate-selection-crash-net.sh outlier, 148,607ms) to keep before/after verification tractable within this dispatch. Selected the 48 smallest-by-line-count remaining suites (14,038 lines total) as Tranche B. All 48 migrated: local pass()/fail()/info() single-line definitions removed and call sites renamed to common_test_pass/_fail/_info (word-boundary-safe regex restricted to call shapes, comments left untouched); a `source "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/common.sh"` line inserted after SCRIPT_DIR where not already sourced. 25 of 48 also had the exact-shape 4-line git-rev-parse+fixed-depth REPO_ROOT fallback block, collapsed to one common_test_repo_root call. 26 of 48 also had the exact-shape WORKDIR=mktemp-d + local cleanup() + trap-cleanup-EXIT triplet (a pattern distinct from Phase 6's bare-trap shape), collapsed to one common_test_workdir_init call -- verified no suite invoked `cleanup` by name outside the trap. common_test_resolve_candidate was not forced onto any suite this tranche (no exact-shape match found worth the risk).

objectives.description: Per-suite assertion-count and PASS/FAIL case-name diff, as in Phase 6
objectives.note: Captured full stdout/stderr for all 48 suites before any edit and after migration (two full before/after passes, ~68s hinted-cost pool each). 40 of 48 byte-identical. 8 cosmetic-only diffs, none touching assertion count or PASS/FAIL case-name text: 4 are non-deterministic mktemp tmpdir path names embedded in [INFO]/[FAIL] lines (test-deploy-orphans.sh, test-lint-deploy-caller-wrap.sh, test-validate-return-meta.sh, test-deploy-propagation.sh); 2 are timing-jitter milliseconds inside otherwise-identical PASS messages (test-run-all-parallel.sh, test-measure-gate-costs.sh); 2 are the same ANSI-color-code loss Phase 6 already established as acceptable (test-task-lock-liveness.sh, test-phase-heartbeat.sh -- confirmed byte-identical after stripping \x1b[...m sequences). Verified via grep-based PASS/FAIL case-name list diff for the two files with the largest textual diff (test-measure-gate-costs.sh: 12/12 case names identical).

objectives.description: Handle the suites that resolve candidates by a non-standard path shape individually rather than forcing them into the harness's resolve_candidate
objectives.note: No suite in this tranche was forced onto common_test_resolve_candidate; none presented the exact shape worth a mechanical extraction this round, consistent with the harness's own documented 22-of-121 adoption rate. Left as a Phase 8 (or later) opportunity.

objectives.description: Record the phase's NET-TEST delta and the running NET-TEST figure
objectives.note: git diff --numstat across the 48 migrated test files plus lib/common.sh: insertions=1449 deletions=1663 NET-TEST=-214 for this phase. Deviation recorded: common_test_fail() in lib/common.sh was extended with an optional $2 diagnostic-detail argument (echoed verbatim after the [FAIL] line) to absorb 4 suites' pre-existing `fail() { ...; [ -n "${2:-}" ] && echo "$2"; }` local override verbatim -- without this extension those 4 suites' diagnostic detail on failure would have been silently dropped by the migration. This is the 'only if a tranche suite needs a harness piece the Phase 4 surface does not yet cover' contingency the plan's own Files-to-modify note anticipated.

approaches_tried.approach: Treat any file containing the substring 'lib/common.sh' anywhere (including inside a `cp ... lib/common.sh` fixture-construction line or a dependency-check comment) as already sourcing the harness, and skip inserting the source line
approaches_tried.reason: 9 of 48 files referenced lib/common.sh only as a fixture-copy source or dependency-existence check, never as an actual `source`/`.` statement in the suite's own shell. Skipping the source-line insertion for these 9 left every renamed common_test_pass/_fail/_info/_repo_root call undefined, producing silent 'command not found' on stderr (with set -uo pipefail, not set -e, so the suite continued and completed with 0 recorded assertions instead of crashing). Caught by the before/after diff showing entire blocks of PASS lines replaced by nothing (e.g. test-errors-append.sh: '14 passed' -> '0 passed'). Fixed by restoring all 9 files from HEAD via `git show HEAD:<path>` and re-running the migration with the detection narrowed to an actual top-level `source`/`.` statement naming lib/common.sh.
